results.title: Lesbian-friendly cafes in Berlin
results.content: Kreuzberg and Neukoelln have the most cafes that run women-only evenings. [...] Example Cafe hosts a queer book club on the first Tuesday of the month. [...] Opening hours change in winter, so check the venue's page.

results.title: Events at Example Cafe
results.content: Open mic night every second Thursday. [...] Queer film club on the last Sunday of the month at 18:00. [...] Tickets are sold at the door.
